subject: Pilot: latency buffer & temporary uptime adjustment for Lighthouse Health - exec clearance needed
messages:
From: Sara Nolan <sara@lighthousehealth.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@lighthousehealth.com
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot timing and performance gates

Jonas / Marissa —

Thanks for the demo yesterday. The team is excited to move to pilot, but two items came up in procurement / SRE review that will block sign-off unless we land on them:

1) Uptime target: we need an explicit temporary tolerance for the pilot window. Our integration will be heavy on embeddings and spikes during nightly batch inference.
2) Latency spikes: acceptable p95 latency for critical endpoints needs a relaxed grace period during early ramp.

We understand Redwood's standard 99.95% uptime and the standard credit formula, but procurement is asking whether we can accept a pilot-specific SLO (99.5% uptime for 90 days) with a fixed service-credit cap and a commercial concession for the pilot pricing.

Can you confirm if Redwood can provide: a one-off SLA amendment for the pilot, a cap on service credits (no more than 5% of monthly invoice), and a 15–20% pilot discount? We also need a short MAP (mutual action plan) to show to our CISO.

Best,
Sara
Sara Nolan
Head of Platform Integrations, Lighthouse Health

--
Attachment: procurement-checklist.pdf (stub)

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Pilot timing and performance gates — proposal for exec clearance

Forwarding Lighthouse's ask. Key asks: temporary uptime 99.5% for 90 days, cap service credits at 5% of monthly invoice, and a commercial pilot discount of 15–20%. Procurement also wants the MAP and a short legal-safe SLA amendment.

Proposed Redwood offer (commercial + SLO carve):
- Pilot term: 90 days starting on go-live.
- Uptime SLO (pilot): 99.5% measured monthly.
- Latency: p95 guardrail increased to 2.2s for the embeddings endpoint during pilot ramp windows; full production p95 0.9s remains the target post-pilot.
- Service credits: capped at 5% of monthly invoice for pilot months; credits paid as invoice adjustments (no cash refunds).
- Commercial: 18% discount on hosted API calls for pilot months; no changes to overage pricing.
- Operational commitments: prioritized onboarding support, weekly SRE syncs for first 4 weeks, increased observability retention for pilot metrics.

Risks / asks from legal/ops: need dealdesk/exec sign-off to deviate SLA language; need Finance to accept credits cap and accounting treatment.

If we agree, I can package a 1-page pilot amendment + MAP and request final sign-off from Ben (VP Sales) and Markus (Head Legal) for signature via DocuSign.

Jonas
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: Lighthouse-pilot-term-sheet.pdf (draft)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Fwd: Pilot timing and performance gates — proposal for exec clearance

Thanks Jonas — solid framing. A couple of commercial notes from Deal Desk:

1) Discount: 18% is acceptable for pilot if contract language includes a clear sunset to standard rates after 90 days and a clause that auto-converts to standard subscription unless customer signs an extension.
2) Credits cap: Finance will accept a 5% cap but wants the credit flow spelled out: credits applied to next invoice, with an absolute maximum credit equal to 5% of the invoice month (not cumulative).
3) SLA amendment: Legal needs to avoid language that limits Redwood's liability broadly — suggest "temporary SLO relief for listed endpoints during the pilot" and include a required operational rollout plan.

Marissa — can you get a one-page amendment + MAP drafted? If we include these guardrails, I recommend Ben signs off. I will also loop Finance (Marcus) to confirm the accounting path.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Deal Desk, Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: internal-deal-notes.txt (stub)

From: marcus_lin@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Pilot timing and performance gates — proposal for exec clearance

Finance is okay with the proposed structure with one condition: any credit larger than 5% in a single month requires escalation to Revenue Ops and a review before issuance (to prevent downstream accounting write-offs). For the pilot we can pre-approve automatic application of credits up to the 5% cap.

Also request that the pilot price be invoiced monthly and that we include a simple KPI reconciliation worksheet in the MAP so both teams can sign the monthly metric.

Marcus Lin
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 14:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Approval: Lighthouse pilot SLA carve and commercial concession — conditional sign-off

Team — after reviewing the summary and legal caveats, I give conditional executive approval to proceed with the pilot under the terms below:

- Pilot term: 90 days, start date to be confirmed by both parties once integration smoke tests pass.
- Uptime (pilot): 99.5% measured monthly for the duration.
- Latency buffer: p95 2.2s for embeddings endpoint during ramp windows; revert after pilot.
- Service credit cap: 5% of monthly invoice; credits applied to next invoice. Any single-month credit above 5% requires Revenue Ops sign-off.
- Commercial concession: 18% discount for pilot months; standard rates resume automatically after pilot unless an extension is signed.
- Documentation: Jonas to upload the one-page SLA amendment + MAP to the HubSpot deal record; Legal (Markus) to review final amendment language; Finance (Marcus) confirmed accounting flow.

Conditions: Legal must remove any absolute liability waiver and include a mutual termination clause if the integration causes unexpected data-handling issues. Also, get a signature from Lighthouse's Procurement and a DocuSign link before activating any discounted billing.

Ben Carter
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference

--
Action items: Jonas to prepare final amendment + MAP and circulate to Sara; Marissa to attach amendment to HubSpot; Markus to complete legal review; Marcus to prepare credit accounting note. DocuSign link requested.
